review_notes: Restore initialization and cache-hit branches of DeferredValue.get_value; a cache hit reuses the stored result and an unset/uncached value invokes the function. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the actual workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
module = importlib.import_module('boltons.formatutils')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'boltons/formatutils.py').resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from boltons.formatutils import DeferredValue
from itertools import count
calls=count(1)
cached=DeferredValue(lambda: next(calls))
first=cached.get_value()
second=cached.get_value()
print("cached_observations", first, second)
assert (first,second)==(1,1)
uncached=DeferredValue(lambda: next(calls), cache_value=False)
assert (uncached.get_value(),uncached.get_value())==(2,3)
print("cached_and_uncached_contract_preserved",True)
PYREPLAY
